description: Keeps C# edits on the validate_patch write path, keeps C# reads on search_index/get_symbol (including via Bash), delivers the write-time checklist on the session's first validate_patch, refreshes the workspace (via a loopback control channel, falling back to a reminder) after creating a new .cs file, and meters every tool call's request and response tokens so MCP and raw-tool routes are measured on one instrument. Every hook is a subcommand of the published server binary, so it runs wherever the .NET runtime the plugin already requires runs - no shell, no shebang, no jq/node/python3. The metering hook alone matches every tool (matcher "*"): it is the only one whose question is about tools it does not otherwise see, and it observes without ever withholding a call.
